name: The Empty Mountain (Không Sơn Tam Kiện)

bonuses.effect: Sit as Thôi Sat (Như Thôi Tọa)
bonuses.rule: every 5 s you are Composed, you bank a Cloud; when you hold 5 Clouds, the next hit on you is answered by a free hundred-echo palm that echoes once for each Cloud you spend.

story: His master's censer, the robe he walked out of Thúy Vi in and the seal he cut that year: the empty mountain's teaching and its last student. Tống wears them and keeps the Heart-Lamp lit on the altar instead.

name: The Reader's Pair (Độc Giả Song Kiện)

bonuses.rule: each soul art you cast within 6 s of ringing the bell lasts 1 s longer; after three such arts, your next soul art is cast at once.

story: The academy's door bell and a robe from her own mine: what the abbey gave the one who reads the Sutra aloud.
